record.original_question: For a Hadamard gap sequence {nk }∞ k=1 , nk+1 /nk ≥ q > 1, is it true that the measure in [0, 2π[ of the set of those points x for which m X lim inf cos(nk x) − ξ = 0, for all ξ ∈ R, m→∞ k=1 equals 2π? (T. Murai)

evidence.quote: For a Hadamard gap sequence {nk }∞ k=1 , nk+1 /nk ≥ q > 1, is it true that the measure in [0, 2π[ of the set of those points x for which m X lim inf cos(nk x) − ξ = 0, for all ξ ∈ R, m→∞ k=1 equals 2π? (T. Murai)

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $\{n_k\}_{k=1}^{\infty}$ be a Hadamard gap sequence of positive numbers, i.e. there exists $q>1$ such that $n_{k+1}/n_k \geq q$ for every $k\geq 1$. For each $x\in[0,2\pi)$ consider the sequence of partial sums
$$S_m(x) = \sum_{k=1}^{m} \cos(n_k x),\qquad m=1,2,\ldots.$$
Define the set
$$E = \Bigl\{ x\in[0,2\pi) : \text{for every } \xi\in\mathbb{R},\ \liminf_{m\to\infty}\bigl|S_m(x)-\xi\bigr| = 0 \Bigr\},$$
that is, the set of those $x$ for which the sequence $(S_m(x))_{m\geq 1}$ is dense in $\mathbb{R}$. 

Question: Is the Lebesgue measure of $E$ equal to $2\pi$, for every Hadamard gap sequence $\{n_k\}$?

status_evidence.snippet: Murai's paper on lacunary series studies value-distribution of Hadamard lacunary trigonometric sums.
status_evidence.claim: Closely related work by Murai on lacunary trigonometric series exists, but does not explicitly state the answer to the precise question asked.

status_evidence.snippet: Paper on value distribution of Hadamard lacunary series.
status_evidence.claim: Related results on value distribution of lacunary cosine sums are known, but not a definitive answer to whether the set in question has measure 2π.
